name: Aeschines: Glimpse of Adulthood
source:
Aeschines: Glimpse of Adulthood is a visual novel that puts you in the sandals of a 4th century Athenian. Prepare yourself for an ancient world involving pederasty, violence, and corruption. Your decisions will have consequences, and not every story will end well!

[From [url=https://antiquity-games.itch.io/aeschines-glimpse-of-adulthood] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《埃斯基涅斯：成年一瞥》是一部视觉小说，让你扮演4世纪雅典人的凉鞋。准备好迎接一个充满鸡奸、暴力和腐败的古代世界吧。你的决定将会产生后果，并不是每个故事都会有好结局！

[来自[url=https://antiquity-games.itch.io/aeschines-glimpse-of-adulthood] itch.io[/url]]
